shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,120p'
git status --short
git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD
cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"
